title: add-jsonschema-strict-mode-response-format-openai-compat
author: Evelyn Chen
description: Add JSON Schema-based structured output support to the API via a new response_format=json_schema option, include strict validation mode, and improve error reporting to match OpenAI compatibility expectations. Context: customers want a first-class way to declare expected output structure for function/tool calling and structured output, and to opt into strict validation that rejects model outputs that don't conform. This change implements a server-side schema validator, adds a strict_mode flag that converts validation failures into structured errors (with error codes and suggested fixes), extends the OpenAI compatibility layer to accept both OpenAI-style 'response_format' and Redwood's new 'response_format', and updates SDKs and docs. Work included: - new openapi extensions for response_format and response_format_options - server-side validation pipeline and error types - migrations for existing endpoints to accept response_format param - improved streaming behavior when validation fails mid-stream (stream aborted with final error event) - comprehensive tests (unit + integration) - docs + migration guide + examples Motivation and notes: - This is primarily an API/edge change with a small runtime validation component. - Strict mode is opt-in; default behavior remains permissive with best-effort repair where possible. - Error payloads are compatible with OpenAI's structured error patterns to make client handling simpler. - Telemetry added for validation failures to drive future model fallback policies. See linked Linear tickets for background.
